columns.archeology_template|scanregistration|log: Stores a numeric registry ID ranging from 1 to 999, with one distinct value per row. Values are integers, no nulls, typical IDs or log entry numbers.
columns.archeology_template|scanregistration|cre: Fixed-length 50-character string containing a crew identifier: letters 'OP' followed by a four-digit number, right-padded with spaces to 50 chars. Most values unique, some repeated.
columns.archeology_template|scanregistration|arc: Six-character string with 'PR' prefix and four-digit number. Unique per record mostly, with a few duplicates. No padding.
columns.archeology_template|scanregistration|log: Stores a numeric log accumulation value with one or two decimal places. Range roughly 0.1 to 5, values vary, not many distinct (422 out of 1000).
columns.archeology_template|scanregistration|ref: Short text field holding reference mark identifiers, usually one or two digits. Values are numeric-looking strings, 48 distinct, many repeats.
columns.archeology_template|scanregistration|ctr: Text field with control point identifiers or counts, ranging from single digit to three digits. 96 distinct values; some repeats.
columns.archeology_template|scanregistration|log: Categorical text describing registration method. Has exactly three allowed values: Feature-based, Target-based, Hybrid. Each appears roughly a third of the time.
columns.archeology_template|scanregistration|tra: String like 'Matrix-1' to 'Matrix-998' indicating a transformation matrix reference. Many distinct values (624), some repeats.
columns.archeology_template|scanregistration|err: Categorical text naming the error measurement scale. Values: 'RMSE', 'Cloud-to-Cloud', 'Cloud-to-Mesh'. Each of three types appears, with RMSE slightly more common.
Numeric error measurement in millimeters, with three decimal places typical. Range 0.006 to 9.996, mostly unique values, few duplicates.
columns.archeology_template|personnel|crewregist: Text(50) with 940 unique non-null values. Format is 'OP' + 4 digits (e.g. OP1005), then spaces to length 50. Values range OP1005 to OP9971.
columns.archeology_template|personnel|crewlabel: Text(50) with 937 distinct values, no nulls. Contains person names like 'Aaron Davis', length 6-24. Pattern is capitalized words, mostly two words.
columns.archeology_template|personnel|leadregist: Text(50) with 898 distinct non-null values. Format is 'SV' + 4 digits (e.g. SV1016), then spaces to length 50. Values range SV1016 to SV9990.
columns.archeology_template|personnel|leadlabel: Text(40) with 933 distinct non-null values. Contains person names like 'Aaron Trujillo', length 8-24. Pattern is capitalized words, mostly two words.
columns.archeology_template|projects|arcregistry: TEXT(50) column containing values exactly 6 characters long, always two uppercase letters 'PR' followed by four digits. Values range from PR1003 to PR9973; all 947 values are distinct.
columns.archeology_template|projects|vesseltag: TEXT(60) column with values made of two capitalized words, usually 'Project' plus a descriptor, e.g., 'Project A', 'Project Yourself'. Length ranges from 9 to 22 characters; 609 distinct labels among 947 rows, with some labels repeated.
columns.archeology_template|projects|fundflux: TEXT column with exactly four distinct values: Government (250), University (243), Private (232), Grant (222). Each value is a single capitalized word of length 5-10 characters; no NULLs.
columns.archeology_template|projects|authpin: TEXT(50) column containing codes starting with three uppercase letters 'PMT' followed by four digits, then trailing spaces to fill 50 characters. Values range from PMT1029 to PMT9974; 910 distinct codes among 947 rows.
columns.archeology_template|projects|authhalt: TEXT column storing dates as 10-character strings in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Values span from 2025-02-20 to 2026-02-19; 338 distinct dates among 947 rows, with many repeated dates.
columns.archeology_template|equipment|equipregis: 50-character string, 'SN' followed by 5 digits, left-padded with spaces to 50 characters. Unique per record.
columns.archeology_template|equipment|equipdesig: String in format 'Model-###' with 3 digits, total 9 characters. 632 distinct models.
columns.archeology_template|equipment|equiptune: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD), ranging from 2024-08-23 to 2025-02-19. 180 distinct dates.
columns.archeology_template|equipment|powerlevel: Integer between 0 and 99, with 101 distinct values. Stored as numeric.
columns.archeology_template|scans|questregistry: 9-character code: three uppercase letters (ASD) followed by six digits, e.g. ASD100419. Uniquely identifies each scan's quest entry.
columns.archeology_template|scans|chronotag: Date-time string like 2024-02-19 18:48:49.504735, with microseconds, length 24-26 characters. Unique per record.
columns.archeology_template|scans|arcref: 6-character code: 'PR' followed by four digits, e.g. PR1003. Identifies archive record; repeats across scans.
columns.archeology_template|scans|crewref: Exactly 50 characters: 'OP' followed by four digits, then trailing spaces, e.g. 'OP1005                                            '. Identifies crew; repeats across scans.
columns.archeology_template|scans|zoneref: 6-character code: 'SC' followed by four digits, e.g. SC1017. Identifies scanned zone; repeats across scans.
columns.archeology_template|scans|scancount: Integer value, observed counts from 1 to 20, with 1-2 digit lengths. Represents scan pass count for the record.
columns.archeology_template|scans|climtune: Categorical value, one of 'Clear', 'Cloudy', 'Rainy', 'Windy'. Length 5-6 characters.
columns.archeology_template|scans|huecatch: Either 'RGB' or 'Grayscale', 3-9 characters, or NULL when no color data. Indicates color mode setting.
columns.archeology_template|scans|fmtfile: 4-character code, always padded with a trailing space. Values: 'E57 ', 'LAS ', 'OBJ ', 'PLY ', 'PTS '.
columns.archeology_template|scans|gbsize: Real numeric value, observed from 0.14 up to 49.49, with one or two decimal places, e.g. 36.67, 5.98.
columns.archeology_template|scans|pressratio: Real number from 1.0 to 9.99, typically formatted with one or two decimal places, e.g. 4.07, 9.24. Represents a unitless ratio.
columns.archeology_template|scans|spanmin: Real number representing minutes, observed values from 10.0 to 191.0, with one decimal place, e.g. 35.0, 123.0.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|qualregistry: Integer registry key with no nulls and 1000 distinct values in 1000 rows, so no duplicates. Values are plain numbers in the observed range 1-999.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|arcref: Fixed-length 6-character code with pattern AADDDD, letters PR followed by 4 digits. No nulls; 947 distinct values, some repeat. Examples: PR1003, PR8078, PR9973.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|crewref: Value is OP followed by four digits, e.g. OP1005, padded with trailing spaces to full 50-character column width. No nulls; 940 distinct values, some repeats.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|accucheck: Text status with three possible values, no nulls. Counts: Completed 366, Pending 322, Not Required 312. Values are 7-12 characters, not padded.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|ctrlstate: Text status stored left-aligned in 50-character field with trailing spaces. No nulls; counts: Failed 368, Pending 327, Passed 305.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|valimeth: Text field listing validation method. Three distinct values, no nulls; counts: Automated 369, Hybrid 319, Visual 312. Length 6-9 characters.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|valistate: Text status for validation outcome. No nulls; three values with counts: Pending 339, Approved 333, Rejected 328. Length 7-8 characters.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|archstat: Text status for archiving process. No nulls; three values: Pending 338, Verified 335, Completed 327. Length 7-9 characters.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|pubstat: Text status with three distinct values, no nulls; counts: Submitted 343, Draft 336, Published 321. Length 5-9 characters.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|copystat: Text status stored in 50-character field with trailing spaces. No nulls; three values: Reserved 341, Restricted 338, Open Access 321.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|refmention: Fixed 13-character code with pattern AAAAAAAA-DDDD, prefix 'Citation' plus four digits. No nulls; 929 distinct values, some repeat. Example: Citation-1000.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|remark: Unstructured English sentence text, 14-67 characters when present. 513 NULLs, 487 non-null values, all effectively unique. Contains ordinary prose-like remarks.
columns.archeology_template|scanspatial|domainre: Integer values 1-999, 1000 distinct, no nulls. Number strings length 1-4, patterns D, DD, DDD, DDDD.
columns.archeology_template|scanspatial|arcref: Six-character codes prefixed PR and four digits, e.g. PR1003 to PR9973. 947 distinct, no nulls. Pattern AADDDD.
columns.archeology_template|scanspatial|crewref: 50-character fixed-width values: OP plus four digits, then trailing spaces. 940 distinct, no nulls. Pattern AADDDD plus trailing spaces.
columns.archeology_template|scanspatial|aream2: Real numeric area values roughly 1.2 to 999.5, with decimals. 998 distinct, no nulls. String length 3-6, patterns DDD.DD, DD.DD, DDD.D, DD.D, D.DD.
columns.archeology_template|scanspatial|volm3: Real numeric volume values roughly 0.38 to 99.9, with decimals. 949 distinct, no nulls. String length 3-5, patterns DD.DD, DD.D, D.DD, D.D.
columns.archeology_template|scanspatial|boxx: Real numeric values with decimal fractions. Profile gives min 0.11, max 9.85; common values include 44.02. 906 distinct, no nulls. Patterns DD.DD, D.DD, DD.D, D.D.
columns.archeology_template|scanspatial|boxy: Real numeric values with decimal fractions. Profile gives min 0.17, max 9.91; common values include 49.13. 900 distinct, no nulls. Patterns DD.DD, D.DD, DD.D, D.D.
columns.archeology_template|scanspatial|boxz: Real numeric values with decimal fractions. Profile gives min 0.14, max 9.89; common values include 48.76. 895 distinct, no nulls. Patterns DD.DD, D.DD, DD.D, D.D.
columns.archeology_template|scanspatial|angleaz: Real/integer-like angle values with decimal or integer forms. Profile min 0.1, max 99.5; common values include 303.7. 875 distinct, no nulls. Patterns DDD.D, DD.D, DDD, D.D, DD.
columns.archeology_template|scanspatial|angletil: Signed angle values, negative to positive. Profile min -0.1, max 9.8; common values include -12.3, 14.3. 597 distinct, no nulls. Patterns -DD.D, DD.D, -D.D, D.D, -DD.
columns.archeology_template|scanspatial|groundsp: Real numeric span values with decimals. Profile min 0.11, max 9.97; common values include 6.66. 631 distinct, no nulls. Patterns D.DD, D.D, DD.D.
columns.archeology_template|scanenvironment|airr: Integer values, no nulls; profile reports 1000 distinct values, min 1, max 999, lengths 1-4 digits. Patterns D, DD, DDD, DDDD.
columns.archeology_template|scanenvironment|zone: Always 6-character text, pattern AADDDD: 'SC' followed by four digits, e.g. SC1017 to SC9995. 942 distinct values, some repeats.
columns.archeology_template|scanenvironment|equi: Fixed 50-character text, pattern AADDDDD followed by trailing spaces; examples 'SN10024', 'SN99937'. 993 distinct values.
columns.archeology_template|scanenvironment|ambi: Real values, no nulls; formats include DD.D, D.D, -D.D, -DD.D. Sample values range from -8.9 to 38.7; 437 distinct values.
columns.archeology_template|scanenvironment|hume: Real values, no nulls; always 4 chars in pattern DD.D. Values range 20.0 to 89.9; 534 distinct values.
columns.archeology_template|scanenvironment|illu: Integer values, no nulls; observed samples include 5932, 13890, 91882, 99850. Patterns DDD, DDDD, DDDDD; 995 distinct values.
columns.archeology_template|scanenvironment|geos: Text values 'Excellent', 'Good', or 'Poor'; 249 nulls, 751 non-null. Lengths 4-9 chars; counts 277, 239, 235.
columns.archeology_template|scanenvironment|trac: Text values 'Fixed' or 'Float', both 5 chars. 332 nulls, 668 non-null; counts 366 and 302.
columns.archeology_template|scanenvironment|link: Text values 'Connected', 'Limited', or 'Disconnected'; no nulls. Lengths 7-12 chars; counts 360, 323, 317.
columns.archeology_template|scanenvironment|phot: 4-character text with trailing space; values '60% ', '70% ', '80% ', '90% '. No nulls; counts 258, 252, 230, 260.
columns.archeology_template|scanenvironment|imgc: Integer values, no nulls; samples 100-997, patterns DD and DDD. 611 distinct values, some repeats.
columns.archeology_template|scanfeatures|traitre: Integer identifier from 1 to 999. No nulls, 1000 records, each value unique. Numeric length 1-4 digits.
columns.archeology_template|scanfeatures|zoneref: Text code like SC1017, SC9995. Exactly 6 chars, pattern AADDDD. 942 distinct values, some repeated.
columns.archeology_template|scanfeatures|equipre: Text code like SN10024, SN99937, always 50 chars with trailing spaces. Pattern AADDDDD plus spaces. 993 distinct values.
columns.archeology_template|scanfeatures|traitex: Categorical text with three values: Automatic (330), Semi-automatic (336), Manual (334). Length 6-14 chars. No nulls.
columns.archeology_template|scanfeatures|traitco: Integer count between 10 and 999. Length 2-4 digits. No nulls. Many repeated values.
columns.archeology_template|scanfeatures|articou: Integer count between 0 and 99. Length 1-3 digits. No nulls. Values repeat frequently.
columns.archeology_template|scanfeatures|structk: Categorical text with five values. Distribution: Foundation 214, Complex 209, Wall 203, Floor 200, Artifact 174. No nulls.
columns.archeology_template|scanfeatures|matkind: Categorical text with five values. Distribution: Mixed 212, Metal 207, Stone 200, Ceramic 191, Organic 190. No nulls.
columns.archeology_template|scanfeatures|huestud: Categorical text with three values. Distribution: Completed 340, Not Required 338, Partial 322. Length 7-12 chars. No nulls.
columns.archeology_template|scanfeatures|texture: Categorical text with three values. Distribution: Completed 343, Not Required 334, Partial 323. Length 7-12 chars. No nulls.
columns.archeology_template|scanfeatures|pattern: Categorical text with three values. Distribution: Not Required 334, Partial 333, Completed 333. Length 7-12 chars. No nulls.
columns.archeology_template|scanmesh|facetregist: Numeric identification value, range 1 to 999, length 1 to 4 digits. Patterns include single digits and multi-digit numbers. Each sampled row shows a distinct value.
columns.archeology_template|scanmesh|zoneref: Text code with pattern AADDDD, always length 6. Starts with uppercase letters 'SC', then four digits, e.g. SC1017 to SC9995.
columns.archeology_template|scanmesh|equipref: Text code with pattern AADDDDD followed by trailing spaces, always length 50. Begins with 'SN', then five digits, e.g. SN10024 to SN99937.
columns.archeology_template|scanmesh|facetverts: Whole number count, range 1,011,255 to 9,996,592, length 6 to 7 digits. All values in sample are distinct.
columns.archeology_template|scanmesh|facetfaces: Whole number count, range 1,006,304 to 9,988,259, length 6 to 7 digits. Nearly all sampled values distinct.
columns.archeology_template|scanmesh|facetresmm: Numeric millimeter value, range 0.12 to 9.99. Formats D.D or D.DD, with one or two decimal places.
columns.archeology_template|scanmesh|texdist: Text code, always 2 characters: digit followed by 'K'. Values are 1K, 2K, 4K. Contains NULLs (246 out of 1000).
columns.archeology_template|scanmesh|texpix: Whole number pixel count, always 4 digits. Values limited to 1024, 2048, 4096, or 8192.
columns.archeology_template|scanmesh|uvmapqual: Text rating with three distinct values: High, Medium, Low. Lengths range 3 to 6 characters, no NULLs.
columns.archeology_template|scanmesh|geomdeltamm: Numeric millimeter value, range 0.1 to 5.0. Formats D.D or D.DD, with one or two decimal places.
columns.archeology_template|sites|zoneregistry: Unique code with format SC plus four digits, e.g. SC1017, SC9995. Always 6 characters; 942 unique codes.
columns.archeology_template|sites|zonelabel: Text label beginning with 'Site-' and ending with a place-style name, e.g. Site-Alexisborough, Site-West Paul. 12-28 characters, 915 distinct labels; not unique.
columns.archeology_template|sites|digunit: Unit code starting with 'Unit-' followed by a letter and number, e.g. Unit-A1, Unit-B11, Unit-D5. 80 distinct values, length 7-8, letter ranges A-D.
columns.archeology_template|sites|gridtrace: Uses cardinal direction and number pairs, e.g. N1-E10, S9-W44, S7-E18. 5-7 characters; patterns ADD-ADD, ADD-AD, AD-ADD, AD-AD.
columns.archeology_template|sites|geox: Decimal coordinate value with decimal fraction, 6-9 characters. Patterns include DD.DDDDD, -DD.DDDDD, D.DDDDD, -D.DDDDD, DD.DDDD; negative values allowed.
columns.archeology_template|sites|geoy: Decimal coordinate value with larger magnitudes than geox, 6-10 characters. Patterns include DD.DDDDD, -DD.DDDDD, DDD.DDDDD, -DDD.DDDDD, DDD.DDDD; negative values allowed.
columns.archeology_template|sites|heightm: Numeric height stored with one decimal place, 3-6 characters. Patterns are DDDD.D, DDD.D, DD.D, D.D; examples include 200.9 and 4251.7.
columns.archeology_template|sites|depthc: Numeric depth stored with one decimal place, 3-5 characters. Patterns are DDD.D, DD.D, D.D; examples include 0.4, 294.3, and 498.4.
columns.archeology_template|sites|phasefactor: One of five period labels: Bronze Age, Medieval, Classical, Iron Age, Neolithic. Values 8-10 characters, roughly equal counts.
columns.archeology_template|sites|guessdate: Calendar year followed by era abbreviation, e.g. 935 CE, 140 BCE, -1000 BCE. Length 5-9 characters; may start with minus sign for BCE years.
columns.archeology_template|sites|typesite: One of five site types: Industrial, Religious, Settlement, Burial, Military. Values 6-10 characters; roughly equal counts.
columns.archeology_template|sites|presstat: One of five statuses: Poor, Excellent, Good, Fair, Critical. Values 4-9 characters; roughly equal counts.
columns.archeology_template|sites|guardhint: Text field padded to 50 characters with trailing spaces; value is either 'Permanent' or 'Temporary'. Nullable; among non-null, 326 permanent and 324 temporary.
columns.archeology_template|sites|entrystat: One of three statuses: Open, Closed, Restricted. Values 4-10 characters; counts 328, 319, 295.
columns.archeology_template|sites|saferank: One of three ranks: High, Minimal, Standard. Values 4-8 characters; counts 349, 310, 283.
columns.archeology_template|sites|insurstat: One of three statuses: Pending, Expired, Active. Values 6-7 characters; counts 344, 299, 299.
columns.archeology_template|sites|riskeval: One of three statuses: Pending, Required, Completed. Values 7-9 characters; counts 329, 320, 293.
columns.archeology_template|sites|healtheval: One of three statuses: Review, Pending, Approved. Values 6-8 characters; counts 330, 320, 292.
columns.archeology_template|sites|envhaz: Text field padded to 50 characters with trailing spaces; value is High, Medium, or Low. Counts: High 328, Medium 315, Low 299.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|flowr: Whole-number registry identifier, mostly unique per record. Values are 1-4 digit numbers such as 1, 10, or 999; the sample contains nearly as many distinct values as rows.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|equip: Fixed 50-character text field with an equipment identifier, always formatted as 'SN' followed by a 5-digit number and trailing spaces. Example: 'SN74231                                           '.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|zoner: 6-character text field formatted as 'SC' plus a 4-digit number, e.g. 'SC8933'. Values repeat occasionally; 942 distinct zones appear in the sample.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|flows: Text field containing one of four software names: Agisoft, RealityCapture, Geomagic, or CloudCompare. Values are 7-14 characters with no padding.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|flowh: Real number indicating elapsed processing hours. Values appear with one decimal place, e.g. 38.9, 43.5, or 12.7; formats are D.D or DD.D (3-4 characters).
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|procc: Integer value from 0-100 representing CPU usage. Common values are two or three digits such as 90, 81, or 76; the profile shows 51 distinct percentage-like values.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|memus: Real number for memory consumption, typically one decimal place, e.g. 118.6, 117.0, or 36.4. Values are 3-5 characters with patterns D.D, DD.D, or DDD.D.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|procg: Integer percentage of GPU usage. Common values are two or three digits such as 99, 96, or 84; profile shows 51 distinct percentage-like values.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|stash: Short text field with three possible values: Cloud, Network, or Local. Each value is 5-7 characters with no padding.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|safeb: Fixed 50-character field, padded with spaces, containing the status: 'Completed', 'Pending', or 'In Progress'. The profile shows roughly equal counts among the three statuses.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|datal: Text field with three classification values: Restricted, Public, or Confidential. Values are 6-12 characters and are not padded.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|metab: Text field indicating the metadata schema: Dublin Core, CIDOC CRM, or Custom. Values are 6-11 characters and may include spaces, e.g. 'Dublin Core'.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|coord: Text field with three values: Local, WGS84, or Custom. Values are 5-6 characters; 'WGS84' is the only one containing digits.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|elevr: Text field with values Local, Arbitrary, or Sea Level. Lengths vary from 5 to 9 characters, including one value with a space.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|remai: Real number representing free space, with one decimal place, e.g. 854.1, 996.0, or 800.1. Values are 3-5 characters, patterns D.D, DD.D, or DDD.D.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|stati: Fixed 50-character field with one of three values: 'Yes', 'No', or 'Partial', padded with trailing spaces. Example: 'Yes                                               '.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|camca: Text field with one of three statuses: Calibrated, Invalid, or Required. Values are 7-10 characters and not padded.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|lensd: Text field with one of three values: Corrected, Uncorrected, or Unknown. Values are 7-11 characters; no padding.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|color: Nullable fixed 50-character field containing 'Adjusted' or 'Required' padded with trailing spaces. About 35% of rows have null; non-null values are all 50 characters.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|flows: Text field with one of five values: Aligned, Final, Textured, Raw, or Meshed. Values are 3-8 characters and not padded.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|fmtve: 3-character text field containing a version number in X.Y format, such as 1.9, 2.3, or 5.9. Always 3 characters with a single dot between digits.
columns.archeology_template|scanconservation|cur: Integer value from 1 to 999, stored in plain numeric format. Length 1 to 4 characters, no nulls, appears unique per row.
columns.archeology_template|scanconservation|arc: Text value always 6 characters in pattern AADDDD: two letters followed by four digits. Range PR1003 to PR9973, mostly unique.
columns.archeology_template|scanconservation|zon: Text value always 6 characters in pattern AADDDD: 'SC' prefix followed by four digits. Range SC1017 to SC9995, mostly unique.
columns.archeology_template|scanconservation|har: One of three values: Minor, Moderate, or Severe. 251 null values out of 1000 records.
columns.archeology_template|scanconservation|cur: One of four categories: Critical, High, Medium, or Low. No null values; distribution roughly even.
columns.archeology_template|scanconservation|str: One of three values: Stable, Moderate, or Unstable. No null values.
columns.archeology_template|scanconservation|int: One of two values: Major or Minor. 318 null values out of 1000 records.
columns.archeology_template|scanconservation|pri: One of two values: Complete or Partial. 327 null values out of 1000 records.
columns.archeology_template|scanpointcloud|cloud: Integer from 1 to 999, mostly unique per record. Identifies cloud registry entry.
columns.archeology_template|scanpointcloud|crewr: Text string 'OP' plus four digits, padded to 50 characters. Identifies crew member or team.
columns.archeology_template|scanpointcloud|arcre: Text string 'PR' plus four digits, six characters total. Identifies arc entity.
columns.archeology_template|scanpointcloud|scanr: Real number from 0.12 to 4.99 mm. Represents point spacing or scan detail.
columns.archeology_template|scanpointcloud|point: Integer from 101,565 to 999,837. Likely points per unit area.
columns.archeology_template|scanpointcloud|cover: Real number, typical values around 86-100, representing percentage of area covered.
columns.archeology_template|scanpointcloud|total: Integer from about 10 million to 100 million. Total number of points in cloud.
columns.archeology_template|scanpointcloud|cloud: Integer from 1,004 to 9,988. Density metric for the point cloud.
columns.archeology_template|scanpointcloud|lappc: Real number from 30.0 to 70.0 with one decimal. Value represents a percentage, meaning unknown.
columns.archeology_template|scanpointcloud|noise: Real number from 0.004 to 1.999. Likely noise level, possibly in decibels.
columns.archeology_template|scanpointcloud|refpc: Real number from 0.1 to 99.9 with one decimal. Represents percentage of reference points.
